description: Package-name reservation placeholder published during the trellis-wiki rebrand; not a usable release
changelog: Name-reservation placeholder for the `trellis-wiki` / `trellis-wiki-core` npm package names during the fork rebrand. Contains no functional CLI; no user should be on this version. The first real release on this package name is 0.7.0.
notes: Documentation-only manifest authored after the fact so the release-manifest chain stays continuous with npm (check-manifest-continuity). No migrations.
